properties.description: Build the Port 101 catalog foundation: `service`, `azure_repo`, and `k8s_resource` blueprints (related to each other) plus mock entities for all three. Use when the user asks to set up a Port catalog, create a service blueprint, model service/repo/k8s relations, load sample/mock data, or start a Port POC catalog from scratch.
properties.instructions:
# Catalog foundations

Your job is to create three related blueprints and load mock entities for each.

## Steps

1. Upsert blueprint `azure_repo`: properties `url` (url), `project` (string), `default_branch` (string, default "main").
2. Upsert blueprint `k8s_resource`: properties `kind` (enum: Deployment, StatefulSet, CronJob), `namespace` (string), `cluster` (string), `replicas` (number).
3. Upsert blueprint `service`: properties `description` (markdown), `language` (enum: Go, Python, Node.js, Java, TypeScript), `lifecycle` (enum: Production, Staging, Experimental), `tier` (enum: Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3), `on_call` (string), `has_readme` (boolean), `repo_url` (string, format url); relations `azure_repo` (single, target azure_repo) and `k8s_resources` (many, target k8s_resource).
4. Upsert one `azure_repo` entity and one `k8s_resource` entity per service (identifiers `azrepo-<service>` and `k8s-<service>`), then upsert the six `service` entities below with their relations set to those repo/resource identifiers.

Service entities (identifier / language / lifecycle / tier / on_call / has_readme):
   - `checkout-service` / Go / Production / Tier 1 / checkout-team / true
   - `auth-service` / Java / Production / Tier 1 / identity-team / true
   - `notifications-service` / Node.js / Staging / Tier 2 / platform-team / true
   - `billing-service` / Python / Production / Tier 1 / (empty) / false
   - `search-service` / TypeScript / Staging / Tier 2 / (empty) / false
   - `inventory-service` / Python / Experimental / Tier 3 / (empty) / false

Report back which blueprints and entities were created or already existed.
